description: This file is a Java source code implementing a SAX parser handler for processing user profile XML data in the RomRaider project. It defines the 'UserProfileHandler' class which parses XML elements related to user profile configuration such as parameters, switches, and external items, and constructs a 'UserProfile' object from them.

classes.name: UserProfileHandler
classes.description: A SAX DefaultHandler subclass that processes XML elements to build a user profile object containing parameters, switches, and external data items.

methods.name: startDocument
methods.description: Initializes the profile item maps at the start of XML parsing.

methods.name: startElement
methods.description: Handles the beginning of XML elements, extracting attributes and populating maps for parameters, switches, and external profile items.

methods.name: getUserProfile
methods.description: Constructs and returns a UserProfile object based on the parsed data.

methods.name: getUserProfileItem
methods.description: Creates a UserProfileItem object from XML element attributes.
